title: Still Holding Me
style: contemporary gospel ballad, inspirational soul, warm grand piano, Hammond organ swells, lush strings, mature soulful female vocal, rich gospel choir, 72 bpm, reverent, triumphant build
negativeTags: trap, EDM, rock, distorted, rap, country
lyrics:
[Intro]
(Soft piano, gentle hum)

[Verse 1]
When the morning came too early
And the night refused to leave
I was counting all my sorrows
You were counting every tear for me

[Pre-Chorus]
I didn't have the words to pray
But You heard me anyway

[Chorus]
You're still holding me
Through the fire and the flood
Still holding me
With a never-failing love
When I couldn't stand, You carried me
Lord, You're still holding me

[Verse 2]
I have walked through empty valleys
Where the silence cut so deep
But Your mercy met me early
And Your peace has guarded me

[Pre-Chorus]
I didn't have the strength to rise
But You lifted up my eyes

[Chorus]
You're still holding me
Through the fire and the flood
Still holding me
With a never-failing love
When I couldn't stand, You carried me
Lord, You're still holding me

[Bridge]
(Choir enters, building)
You never let go, You never let go
Every storm, every road, You never let go
(Lead ad-libs over choir)

[Final Chorus]
(Key change, full choir)
You're still holding me
Through the fire and the flood
Still holding me
With a never-failing love
When I couldn't stand, You carried me
Lord, You're still holding me

[Outro]
(Piano and soft choir)
Still holding me
